name: dla
description: Detect Leak Anywhere: evidence-gated memory leak diagnosis for JVM, Go, Rust, Node/TS, Python and native code. Diagnosis only; it never edits project source.

redaction.title: Value redaction
redaction.description: How values read from the target are shown to the model: 'shapes' (length, character pattern and a salted hash only, the default) or 'raw' (verbatim values, only if you accept that they enter the conversation).

privilege_ceiling.title: Privilege ceiling
privilege_ceiling.description: Highest privilege tier DLA may ask you to approve, from 1 (read-only) to 4 (may rebuild and run the target in a scratch copy). The default is 4; you are still asked before each tier is used.

time_budget.title: Default time budget
time_budget.description: Wall-clock budget for one diagnosis run, such as 90s, 45m or 2h. The default is 60m.
